mapper.select: SELECT product_num, product_name, product_price, product_img, local_gu_name FROM product order by product_num desc
SELECT DISTINCT local_gu_name FROM product WHERE local_gu_name IS NOT NULL
SELECT product_num, product_name, product_price, product_img, local_gu_name FROM product WHERE local_gu_name = #{localGuName} order by product_num desc
SELECT product_num, product_name, product_price, product_img, local_gu_name FROM product WHERE product_price = '나눔' order by product_num desc

SELECT product_num, product_name, product_price, product_img, local_gu_name FROM product WHERE (#{category} IS NULL OR category_name = #{category}) AND (#{localGu} IS NULL OR local_gu_name = #{localGu}) AND (#{share} IS NULL OR product_price = '나눔')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_name, product_info, product_price, local_gu_name, product_img ,member_idx) VALUES (#{productName}, #{productInfo}, #{productPrice}, #{localGuName}, #{productImg}, #{memberIdx})
